quotes.en: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
quotes.zh: 你一生的幸福，取决于你思想的质量。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
quotes.zh: 不要再花时间争论好人该是什么样子，去做一个好人。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
quotes.zh: 阻碍行动的东西反而推动行动，挡在路上的东西就成了路。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it.
quotes.zh: 不义之事不要做，不实之言不要讲。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: Confine yourself to the present.
quotes.zh: 把自己安放在当下。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself.
quotes.zh: 幸福的生活所需极少，一切都在你自己心里。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: The art of living is more like wrestling than dancing.
quotes.zh: 生活的技艺更像摔跤，而不是跳舞。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: Look well into yourself; there is a source of strength that will always spring up if you will always look.
quotes.zh: 好好向内看，那里有一股力量，只要你肯常常去看，它就会不断涌出。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: Loss is nothing else but change, and change is nature's delight.
quotes.zh: 失去不过是变化，而变化正是自然的乐趣。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: How much time he gains who does not look to see what his neighbor says or does or thinks.
quotes.zh: 不去打听邻人说了什么、做了什么、想了什么的人，省下多少时间。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: Do not act as if you were going to live ten thousand years. While you live, while it is in your power, be good.
quotes.zh: 不要以为自己能活一万年。趁你还活着，趁你还有能力，去做个好人。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: A man's worth is no greater than his ambitions.
quotes.zh: 一个人的价值，不会超过他所追求的东西。
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.en: No man is free who is not master of himself.
quotes.zh: 不能主宰自己的人，没有一个是自由的。
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.en: It is not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
quotes.zh: 重要的不是发生了什么，而是你如何回应。
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.en: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
quotes.zh: 先对自己说清你要成为什么样的人，然后去做该做的事。
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.en: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
quotes.zh: 财富不在于拥有很多，而在于所求很少。
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.en: If you want to improve, be content to be thought foolish and stupid.
quotes.zh: 想要长进，就要甘心被人当作愚蠢。
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.en: Only the educated are free.
quotes.zh: 唯有受过教育的人才是自由的。
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.en: There is only one way to happiness: cease worrying about things beyond the power of your will.
quotes.zh: 通往幸福只有一条路：不再为意志之外的事忧心。
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.en: Freedom is not procured by a full enjoyment of what is desired, but by controlling the desire.
quotes.zh: 自由不是靠满足欲望得来的，而是靠克制欲望得来的。
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.en: Man is not worried by real problems so much as by his imagined anxieties about real problems.
quotes.zh: 人更多是被自己对问题的想象所困扰，而不是被问题本身。
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.en: Make progress, and do not be content with the appearance of it.
quotes.zh: 要真正长进，不要满足于长进的样子。
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.en: Nature gave men two ears and one mouth so that we might hear more and speak less.
quotes.zh: 自然给人两只耳朵一张嘴，是要我们多听少说。
quotes.author: Zeno of Citium

quotes.en: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
quotes.zh: 我们受苦，多半是在想象里，而不是在现实里。
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.en: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
quotes.zh: 不是我们能活的时间太短，而是我们浪费得太多。
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.en: While we wait for life, life passes.
quotes.zh: 我们等着生活开始，生活却已经过去了。
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.en: Life is long if you know how to use it.
quotes.zh: 只要懂得如何使用，人生就是漫长的。
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.en: He who is brave is free.
quotes.zh: 勇敢的人才是自由的。
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.en: Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
quotes.zh: 困难磨砺心智，正如劳作锻炼身体。
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.en: Associate with people who are likely to improve you.
quotes.zh: 要与那些能使你长进的人来往。
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.en: You act like mortals in all that you fear, and like immortals in all that you desire.
quotes.zh: 在恐惧之事上你像个凡人，在欲望之事上你却像个不死者。
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.en: The whole future lies in uncertainty: live immediately.
quotes.zh: 整个未来都悬在不确定里，那就立刻开始生活。
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.en: Retire into yourself as much as you can.
quotes.zh: 尽可能地退回到自身之中。
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.en: No one can live happily who has become his own enemy.
quotes.zh: 成为自己敌人的人，无法过得幸福。
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.en: To learn and practise what one has learned, is that not a pleasure?
quotes.zh: 学了又时时温习实践，不也是一种快乐吗？
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: Learning without thought is labour lost; thought without learning is perilous.
quotes.zh: 只学不思是白费功夫，只思不学则很危险。
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: When you know a thing, to hold that you know it; and when you do not know a thing, to allow that you do not know it: this is knowledge.
quotes.zh: 知道的就说知道，不知道的就承认不知道，这就是真知。
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: To see what is right and not to do it is want of courage.
quotes.zh: 看见该做的事却不去做，就是缺少勇气。
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: I will not be concerned at men not knowing me; I will be concerned at my own want of ability.
quotes.zh: 我不愁别人不了解我，只愁自己能力不足。
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: When we see men of worth, we should think of equaling them; when we see men of a contrary character, we should turn inwards and examine ourselves.
quotes.zh: 见到贤者，想着与他看齐；见到不贤者，就回头检查自己。
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: The cautious seldom err.
quotes.zh: 谨慎的人很少出错。
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: Virtue is not left to stand alone. He who practises it will have neighbours.
quotes.zh: 德行不会孤单，实行它的人身边总会有人聚拢。
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: The superior man is calm and serene; the mean man is always anxious and distressed.
quotes.zh: 君子从容安宁，小人总是忧急不安。
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: What you do not want done to yourself, do not do to others.
quotes.zh: 自己不愿承受的事，不要加在别人身上。
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: The man of virtue makes the difficulty to be overcome his first business, and the reward comes afterwards.
quotes.zh: 有德之人先把难处解决，收获则留到后面。
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: Hold faithfulness and sincerity as first principles.
quotes.zh: 把忠信与真诚放在首位。
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.en: I am a citizen of the world.
quotes.zh: 我是世界公民。
quotes.author: Diogenes the Cynic

quotes.en: Stand out of my sunlight.
quotes.zh: 请别挡住我的阳光。
quotes.author: Diogenes the Cynic

quotes.en: The foundation of every state is the education of its youth.
quotes.zh: 每一个国家的根基，都在于对青年的教育。
quotes.author: Diogenes the Cynic

quotes.en: It is a poor plan that cannot be changed.
quotes.zh: 一个改不了的计划，就是糟糕的计划。
quotes.author: Publilius Syrus

quotes.en: We are interested in others when they are interested in us.
quotes.zh: 别人对我们有兴趣，我们才会对别人有兴趣。
quotes.author: Publilius Syrus

quotes.en: Time is the most valuable thing a man can spend.
quotes.zh: 时间是一个人所能花掉的最宝贵的东西。
quotes.author: Theophrastus

quotes.en: Hope is the last thing that dies in man.
quotes.zh: 希望是人身上最后死去的东西。
quotes.author: Diogenes Laertius

quotes.en: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.zh: 千里之行，始于足下。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom.
quotes.zh: 知人者智，自知者明。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: Mastering others is strength; mastering yourself is true power.
quotes.zh: 胜人者有力，自胜者强。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: The soft overcomes the hard; the gentle overcomes the rigid.
quotes.zh: 柔能克刚，弱能胜强。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: A leader is best when people barely know that he exists.
quotes.zh: 最好的首领，是百姓几乎感觉不到他存在的那一位。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: He who knows that enough is enough will always have enough.
quotes.zh: 懂得适可而止的人，永远都会觉得够用。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: Water is the softest thing, yet it can wear away the hardest.
quotes.zh: 水是天下最柔软的东西，却能穿蚀最坚硬的东西。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: The sage does not hoard. The more he does for others, the more he has.
quotes.zh: 圣人从不囤积，越是为人付出，自己反而越丰足。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: He who does not trust enough will not be trusted.
quotes.zh: 对别人不够信任的人，也得不到别人的信任。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: Difficult things are done while they are still easy.
quotes.zh: 难事要在它还容易的时候就着手去做。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: Sincere words are not fine; fine words are not sincere.
quotes.zh: 真话不漂亮，漂亮话不真。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: To know when to stop is to avoid danger.
quotes.zh: 知道何时停下，就能避开危险。
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.en: Once I dreamed I was a butterfly, and now I no longer know whether I am a man who dreamed of being a butterfly.
quotes.zh: 我曾梦见自己是蝴蝶，醒来后竟分不清，是我梦见做了蝴蝶，还是蝴蝶梦见成了我。
quotes.author: Zhuangzi

quotes.en: You cannot speak of the sea to a frog in a well.
quotes.zh: 井里的青蛙，没法同它谈海。
quotes.author: Zhuangzi

quotes.en: The fish trap exists because of the fish; once you have the fish, you can forget the trap.
quotes.zh: 鱼篓是为了鱼而存在的，得到了鱼，就可以忘掉鱼篓。
quotes.author: Zhuangzi

quotes.en: Words are used to express meaning; when you grasp the meaning, you can forget the words.
quotes.zh: 语言是用来表达意思的，领会了意思，就可以放下语言。
quotes.author: Zhuangzi

quotes.en: When the shoe fits, the foot is forgotten.
quotes.zh: 鞋子合脚时，脚就被忘掉了。
quotes.author: Zhuangzi

quotes.en: The perfect man has no self.
quotes.zh: 至人没有自我。
quotes.author: Zhuangzi

quotes.en: Everyone knows the usefulness of the useful, but no one knows the usefulness of the useless.
quotes.zh: 人人都知道有用的用处，却没有人知道无用的用处。
quotes.author: Zhuangzi

quotes.en: Great knowledge is broad and unhurried; small knowledge is narrow and anxious.
quotes.zh: 大智慧宽广从容，小聪明局促计较。
quotes.author: Zhuangzi

quotes.en: The people are the most important; the state comes next; the ruler is the lightest.
quotes.zh: 民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻。
quotes.author: Mencius

quotes.en: A great man is one who never loses his childlike heart.
quotes.zh: 大人者，不失其赤子之心者也。
quotes.author: Mencius

quotes.en: When heaven is about to lay a great task on a man, it first trains his mind through hardship.
quotes.zh: 天将降大任于斯人也，必先苦其心志。
quotes.author: Mencius

quotes.en: The path of duty lies close at hand, yet men seek it far away.
quotes.zh: 道在近处，人们却偏要往远处去找。
quotes.author: Mencius

quotes.en: If you do not study, you will not know; if you do not ask, you will not learn.
quotes.zh: 不学就不会明白，不问就学不到东西。
quotes.author: Mencius

quotes.en: Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will never be in danger.
quotes.zh: 知彼知己，百战不殆。
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.en: Supreme excellence consists in breaking the enemy's resistance without fighting.
quotes.zh: 最高明的胜利，是不战而使敌人屈服。
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.en: The greatest victory is that which requires no battle.
quotes.zh: 最伟大的胜利，是不必交战的那一场。
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.en: All warfare is based on deception.
quotes.zh: 一切用兵，都以出其不意为本。
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.en: Speed is the essence of war.
quotes.zh: 快速是打仗的要害。
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.en: He who knows when he can fight and when he cannot will be victorious.
quotes.zh: 懂得何时该打、何时不该打的人，才能取胜。
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.en: Regard your soldiers as your children, and they will follow you into the deepest valleys.
quotes.zh: 把士兵当作自己的孩子，他们就会跟你走进最深的谷地。
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.en: The soldier works out his victory in relation to the foe whom he is facing.
quotes.zh: 士兵的胜算，是从眼前的对手身上算出来的。
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.en: In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
quotes.zh: 混乱之中，也藏着机会。
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.en: He who relies on his own readiness will not be defeated.
quotes.zh: 凡事靠自己事先准备的人，不会被击败。
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.en: All that we are is the result of what we have thought.
quotes.zh: 我们成为什么，是念头累积的结果。
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.en: Better than a thousand hollow words is one word that brings peace.
quotes.zh: 千句空话，不如一句能带来安宁的话。
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.en: Hatred is never appeased by hatred; hatred is appeased by love.
quotes.zh: 恨永远无法用恨平息，只能用爱平息。
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.en: If you find no one to support you on the path, walk alone.
quotes.zh: 同行的人找不到，就独自走下去。
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.en: Victory breeds hatred, for the defeated live in pain.
quotes.zh: 胜利招来怨恨，因为失败者活在痛苦里。
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.en: Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future; concentrate the mind on the present moment.
quotes.zh: 不要停留在过去，也不要空想未来，把心放在当下的这一刻。
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.en: He who holds back rising anger like a rolling chariot is a real driver.
quotes.zh: 能像勒住奔驰的车一样止住怒意的人，才是真正的驾驭者。
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.en: A man is not called wise because he talks a lot.
quotes.zh: 话多的人，并不能因此被称作有智慧。
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.en: Drop by drop is the water pot filled; little by little the wise man fills himself with good.
quotes.zh: 水滴一点点把罐子装满，智者也是一点点把自己装满善。
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.en: Conquer the angry by love; conquer the cruel by kindness.
quotes.zh: 以爱降服愤怒，以善降服残忍。
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.en: You have the right to work, but never to the fruit of your work.
quotes.zh: 你有权去做事，却无权占有做事的成果。
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.en: Let a man lift himself by his own self.
quotes.zh: 人要靠自己把自己扶起来。
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.en: The mind is restless and hard to restrain, but it is subdued by practice.
quotes.zh: 心念躁动难以约束，惟靠反复练习才能安定。
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.en: He who sees action in inaction and inaction in action is wise among men.
quotes.zh: 能在不为之中看见作为、在作为之中看见不为的人，才是人中的智者。
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.en: The soul is neither born, nor does it ever die.
quotes.zh: 灵魂从不曾诞生，也从不曾死去。
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.en: Slow and steady wins the race.
quotes.zh: 稳扎稳打，才能赢得比赛。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: A liar will not be believed, even when he speaks the truth.
quotes.zh: 爱说谎的人，即使说真话也没人肯信。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Birds of a feather flock together.
quotes.zh: 羽毛相同鸟，总爱飞在一处。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Look before you leap.
quotes.zh: 跳之前先看清楚。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Union gives strength.
quotes.zh: 同心协力，就有力量。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Do not count your chickens before they are hatched.
quotes.zh: 蛋还没孵出来，先别数小鸡。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: The grapes are sour.
quotes.zh: 吃不到的葡萄，总是酸的。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Necessity is the mother of invention.
quotes.zh: 需要是发明之母。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Little by little does the trick.
quotes.zh: 一点点来，事情就办成了。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Do not judge by appearances.
quotes.zh: 不要只看外表就下判断。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Better to starve free than be a fat slave.
quotes.zh: 饿着做自由人，胜过饱着做奴隶。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Gratitude is the sign of a noble soul.
quotes.zh: 感恩是高贵心灵的标志。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Self-help is the best help.
quotes.zh: 自己救自己，才是最好的帮助。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Injuries may be forgiven, but never forgotten.
quotes.zh: 伤害可以被原谅，却很难被忘掉。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: A doubtful friend is worse than a certain enemy.
quotes.zh: 靠不住的朋友，比明确的敌人更危险。
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.en: Fortune favors the bold.
quotes.zh: 命运眷顾胆大的人。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: While there is life, there is hope.
quotes.zh: 只要还活着，就还有希望。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: Every man is the architect of his own fortune.
quotes.zh: 每个人都是自己命运的建造者。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: Practice is the best of all instructors.
quotes.zh: 练习是最好的老师。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: One man's meat is another man's poison.
quotes.zh: 对一个人是美食，对另一个人可能是毒药。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: The die is cast.
quotes.zh: 骰子已经掷出，无法再收回。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: I came, I saw, I conquered.
quotes.zh: 我来了，我看见了，我征服了。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: Hasten slowly.
quotes.zh: 要快，但要稳。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: If you wish for peace, prepare for war.
quotes.zh: 想要和平，就得先做好打仗的准备。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: To err is human.
quotes.zh: 犯错是人之常情。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: Better late than never.
quotes.zh: 迟做总比不做强。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: Nature abhors a vacuum.
quotes.zh: 自然厌恶空白。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: There is truth in wine.
quotes.zh: 酒里藏着真话。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: The exception proves the rule.
quotes.zh: 例外恰恰证明了规则的存在。
quotes.author: Latin proverb

quotes.en: No man ever steps in the same river twice.
quotes.zh: 人不能两次踏进同一条河。
quotes.author: Heraclitus

quotes.en: Everything flows and nothing stays.
quotes.zh: 万物都在流动，没有一样停住不变。
quotes.author: Heraclitus

quotes.en: The sun is new each day.
quotes.zh: 太阳每天都是新的。
quotes.author: Heraclitus

quotes.en: Character is destiny.
quotes.zh: 性格就是命运。
quotes.author: Heraclitus

quotes.en: Nature loves to hide.
quotes.zh: 自然喜欢把自己藏起来。
quotes.author: Heraclitus

quotes.en: War is the father of all and the king of all.
quotes.zh: 战争是万物之父，也是万物之王。
quotes.author: Heraclitus

quotes.en: Know yourself.
quotes.zh: 认识你自己。
quotes.author: Greek proverb

quotes.en: The most difficult thing in life is to know yourself.
quotes.zh: 人生最难的事，是认清自己。
quotes.author: Thales

quotes.en: Never find your delight in another's misfortune.
quotes.zh: 不要从别人的不幸里寻开心。
quotes.author: Publilius Syrus

quotes.en: Count no man happy until the end is known.
quotes.zh: 在结局揭晓之前，不要说谁幸福。
quotes.author: Solon

quotes.en: Learn to obey before you command.
quotes.zh: 先学会服从，再去发号施令。
quotes.author: Solon

quotes.en: Nothing in excess.
quotes.zh: 凡事都不要过头。
quotes.author: Solon

quotes.en: Man is the measure of all things.
quotes.zh: 人是万物的尺度。
quotes.author: Protagoras

quotes.en: There are two sides to every question.
quotes.zh: 每个问题都有两面。
quotes.author: Protagoras

quotes.en: The beginning is half of the whole.
quotes.zh: 开端就是全部的一半。
quotes.author: Pythagoras

quotes.en: Do not say a little in many words, but a great deal in a few.
quotes.zh: 不要用许多话讲一点点意思，要用几句话讲很多意思。
quotes.author: Pythagoras

quotes.en: Anger begins in folly and ends in repentance.
quotes.zh: 愤怒始于愚昧，终于悔恨。
quotes.author: Pythagoras

quotes.en: Happiness dwells not in gold, but in the soul.
quotes.zh: 幸福不在黄金里，而在心灵里。
quotes.author: Democritus

quotes.en: A word is the shadow of a deed.
quotes.zh: 言语是行为的影子。
quotes.author: Democritus

quotes.en: Many much-learned men have no intelligence.
quotes.zh: 许多博览群书的人，并没有真正的见识。
quotes.author: Democritus

quotes.en: The pride of youth is in strength, the pride of age in wisdom.
quotes.zh: 青年以力量自豪，老年以智慧自豪。
quotes.author: Democritus

quotes.en: By seeking, men find what the gods did not reveal to them at once.
quotes.zh: 神没有一次把一切都告诉人，人是靠不断寻求才找到的。
quotes.author: Xenophanes

quotes.en: Actions speak louder than words.
quotes.zh: 行动比言语更有说服力。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: A stitch in time saves nine.
quotes.zh: 及时补一针，省得日后缝九针。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: Where there is a will, there is a way.
quotes.zh: 有决心，就有办法。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: Honesty is the best policy.
quotes.zh: 诚实是最好的策略。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: Too many cooks spoil the broth.
quotes.zh: 厨子太多，反而做坏了汤。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: The grass is always greener on the other side of the fence.
quotes.zh: 篱笆那边的草，看起来总是更绿。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
quotes.zh: 患难之中肯来的人，才是真朋友。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: Every cloud has a silver lining.
quotes.zh: 再暗的云，也镶着一道银边。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: Practice makes perfect.
quotes.zh: 反复练习，才能做到完美。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: Haste makes waste.
quotes.zh: 赶得太急，反而浪费更多。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: Still waters run deep.
quotes.zh: 静水之下，往往很深。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: The early bird catches the worm.
quotes.zh: 起得早的鸟，才捉得到虫。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: Do not put all your eggs in one basket.
quotes.zh: 别把全部鸡蛋放在一个篮子里。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: Do not bite the hand that feeds you.
quotes.zh: 不要去咬喂养你的那只手。
quotes.author: English proverb

quotes.en: A man who asks is a fool for five minutes; a man who never asks is a fool forever.
quotes.zh: 问一次只愚五分钟，不问便愚一辈子。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: The palest ink is better than the best memory.
quotes.zh: 最淡的墨，也胜过最好的记性。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: A fall into the pit, a gain in your wit.
quotes.zh: 吃一次亏，长一分智。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: Distance tests a horse's strength, and time reveals a person's heart.
quotes.zh: 路远才知马力，日久才见人心。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: Learning is like rowing upstream; not to advance is to drop back.
quotes.zh: 学习如同逆水行舟，不进则退。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: Teachers open the door, but you must enter by yourself.
quotes.zh: 老师只能把门打开，进去还得靠你自己。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: A thousand cups of wine are too few when friends meet.
quotes.zh: 好友相逢，千杯也嫌少。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago; the second best time is now.
quotes.zh: 种树最好的时候是二十年前，其次是现在。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: One generation plants the trees, another enjoys the shade.
quotes.zh: 上一代种树，下一代乘凉。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: An inch of time is an inch of gold, but gold cannot buy an inch of time.
quotes.zh: 一寸光阴一寸金，寸金难买寸光阴。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: Do not fear going slowly; fear standing still.
quotes.zh: 不怕走得慢，就怕站着不动。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: A horse cannot be judged by its coat, nor a man by his clothes.
quotes.zh: 不能凭毛色看马，也不能凭衣冠看人。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: Better a diamond with a flaw than a pebble without.
quotes.zh: 有瑕疵的钻石，也胜过没瑕疵的石头。
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.en: Fall down seven times, get up eight.
quotes.zh: 跌倒七次，就爬起来八次。
quotes.author: Japanese proverb

quotes.en: One hundred years of idleness is worse than one day of honest work.
quotes.zh: 闲混百年，不如踏实干一天。
quotes.author: Japanese proverb

quotes.en: Even a fool who takes advice is better than a fool who will not.
quotes.zh: 肯听劝的愚人，胜过不听劝的愚人。
quotes.author: Japanese proverb

quotes.en: A single arrow is easily broken, but not ten in a bundle.
quotes.zh: 一支箭容易折断，一束箭就折不断。
quotes.author: Japanese proverb

quotes.en: The tongue is the only tool that grows sharper with use.
quotes.zh: 舌头是唯一越用越锋利的工具。
quotes.author: Japanese proverb

quotes.en: He who has hope has everything.
quotes.zh: 有希望的人，就拥有一切。
quotes.author: Arabic proverb

quotes.en: Patience is the key to joy.
quotes.zh: 忍耐是通往喜悦的钥匙。
quotes.author: Arabic proverb

quotes.en: Write the bad things done to you in sand, and the good things on stone.
quotes.zh: 别人对你的坏，写在沙上；对你的好，刻在石上。
quotes.author: Arabic proverb

quotes.en: The wound of a friend hurts more than the sword of an enemy.
quotes.zh: 朋友造成的伤，比敌人的刀更疼。
quotes.author: Arabic proverb

quotes.en: Learning is the light of the soul.
quotes.zh: 学问是心灵的光。
quotes.author: Arabic proverb

quotes.en: A spoken word is like a stone once thrown; it cannot be taken back.
quotes.zh: 话说出口，如同石头扔出，再也收不回来。
quotes.author: Persian proverb

quotes.en: Do not cut the branch you are sitting on.
quotes.zh: 不要砍掉自己正坐着的树枝。
quotes.author: Persian proverb

quotes.en: Every day is a new life.
quotes.zh: 每一天都是一次新生。
quotes.author: Persian proverb

quotes.en: Patience and hard work will grind a stone into a mill.
quotes.zh: 耐心加苦干，石头也能磨成磨盘。
quotes.author: Russian proverb

quotes.en: Do not praise yourself in the evening; wait until morning.
quotes.zh: 晚上别急着夸自己，等到早晨再说。
quotes.author: Russian proverb

quotes.en: A good friend is better than a hundred servants.
quotes.zh: 一个好朋友，胜过一百个仆人。
quotes.author: Russian proverb

quotes.en: Tomorrow's sun does not shine today.
quotes.zh: 明天的太阳，照不亮今天。
quotes.author: Spanish proverb

quotes.en: A good word is a short word, and yet it lasts long.
quotes.zh: 好话不长，却能长久留存。
quotes.author: Spanish proverb

quotes.en: Who begins many things finishes none.
quotes.zh: 什么都开头的人，什么都做不完。
quotes.author: German proverb

quotes.en: Shared joy is double joy; shared sorrow is half sorrow.
quotes.zh: 快乐分出去会加倍，忧愁分出去会减半。
quotes.author: German proverb

quotes.en: He who begins well has half finished.
quotes.zh: 开头开得好，就等于完成了一半。
quotes.author: Italian proverb

quotes.en: A person who does not know how to be silent does not know how to speak.
quotes.zh: 不懂沉默的人，也不懂怎样说话。
quotes.author: Italian proverb

quotes.en: To know a person well, you must eat a peck of salt with him.
quotes.zh: 要真正了解一个人，得同他一起吃下一斗盐。
quotes.author: French proverb

quotes.en: Good things come to those who wait, but only what is left by those who hurry.
quotes.zh: 好事留给肯等的人，但往往只是匆忙者挑剩下的。
quotes.author: French proverb

quotes.en: A soft answer turneth away wrath.
quotes.zh: 温和的回答能平息怒气。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine.
quotes.zh: 喜乐的心如同一剂良药。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
quotes.zh: 骄傲先于毁灭，狂傲先于跌倒。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart, and lean not on thine own understanding.
quotes.zh: 要全心信靠，不要单凭自己的聪明。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: Train up a child in the way he should go.
quotes.zh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的路。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: A friend loveth at all times.
quotes.zh: 真正的朋友，任何时候都怀着爱。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty.
quotes.zh: 不轻易发怒的人，胜过勇士。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
quotes.zh: 敬畏之心，是智慧的开端。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
quotes.zh: 一句说得合宜的话，如同银盘里的金苹果。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
quotes.zh: 少而正直，胜过多而不义。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent.
quotes.zh: 心里有智慧的人，会被称作明辨之人。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: With all thy getting get understanding.
quotes.zh: 无论你求什么，先求明白事理。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise.
quotes.zh: 与智者同行的人，自己也会变得明智。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick.
quotes.zh: 希望一再被推迟，心就会生病。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them.
quotes.zh: 正直人的诚实，会为他们引路。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
quotes.zh: 万事各有其时，天下一切作为都有定时。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: A time to keep silence, and a time to speak.
quotes.zh: 什么时候该沉默，什么时候该开口，都有其分。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might.
quotes.zh: 手边该做的事，就尽力去做。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: A good name is better than precious ointment.
quotes.zh: 好名声胜过珍贵的香膏。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labour.
quotes.zh: 两个人胜过一个人，因为同工的果效更好。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: Cast thy bread upon the waters, for thou shalt find it after many days.
quotes.zh: 把粮食撒在水面上，多日之后必能寻见。
quotes.author: Solomon

quotes.en: Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.
quotes.zh: 温柔的人有福了，因为他们必承受土地。
quotes.author: Matthew

quotes.en: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
quotes.zh: 清心的人有福了，因为他们必得见神。
quotes.author: Matthew

quotes.en: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works.
quotes.zh: 让你的光在人前照亮，使人看见你的善行。
quotes.author: Matthew

quotes.en: No man can serve two masters.
quotes.zh: 没有人能同时服侍两个主人。
quotes.author: Matthew

quotes.en: Seek ye first the kingdom of God, and all these things shall be added unto you.
quotes.zh: 先把最重要的事放在首位，其余的自然会加给你。
quotes.author: Matthew

quotes.en: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
quotes.zh: 不要论断别人，免得自己被论断。
quotes.author: Matthew

quotes.en: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find.
quotes.zh: 开口求，就会得到；去寻求，就会寻见。
quotes.author: Matthew

quotes.en: Wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction.
quotes.zh: 通往毁灭的门是宽的，路是大的。
quotes.author: Matthew

quotes.en: A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country.
quotes.zh: 先知在本乡本地，反倒不受尊敬。
quotes.author: Matthew

quotes.en: Whosoever will be great among you, let him be your servant.
quotes.zh: 谁想在你们中间为大，就让他做你们的仆人。
quotes.author: Matthew

quotes.en: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
quotes.zh: 主是我的牧者，我一无所缺。
quotes.author: David

quotes.en: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil.
quotes.zh: 纵使我走过死荫的幽谷，也不怕遭害。
quotes.author: David

quotes.en: Be still, and know that I am God.
quotes.zh: 安静下来，认清谁在掌管一切。
quotes.author: David

quotes.en: Wait on the Lord; be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart.
quotes.zh: 要等候，要鼓起勇气，你的心必得坚固。
quotes.author: David

quotes.en: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
quotes.zh: 你的话是我脚前的灯，是我路上的光。
quotes.author: David

quotes.en: Children are an heritage of the Lord.
quotes.zh: 儿女是所赐下的产业。
quotes.author: David

quotes.en: Man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
quotes.zh: 人生来就要经历患难，如同火星总是向上飞。
quotes.author: Job

quotes.en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth?
quotes.zh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？
quotes.author: Job

quotes.en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear, but now mine eye seeth thee.
quotes.zh: 从前我风闻有你，如今亲眼看见你。
quotes.author: Job

quotes.en: Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither.
quotes.zh: 我赤身而来，也必赤身而归。
quotes.author: Job

quotes.en: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.
quotes.zh: 我的日子比梭子还快，转眼就过。
quotes.author: Job

quotes.en: They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles.
quotes.zh: 等候的人必重新得力，必如鹰展翅上腾。
quotes.author: Isaiah

quotes.en: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth, but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
quotes.zh: 草会枯，花会谢，而真理的话永远长存。
quotes.author: Isaiah

quotes.en: What doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
quotes.zh: 所要求于你的，岂不就是行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心而行吗？
quotes.author: Micah

quotes.en: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
quotes.zh: 如今常存的有信、有望、有爱，其中最大的是爱。
quotes.author: Paul

quotes.en: Charity beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
quotes.zh: 爱能包容一切，相信一切，盼望一切，忍耐一切。
quotes.author: Paul

quotes.en: Let us not be weary in well doing, for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
quotes.zh: 行善不可丧志，到了时候必有收成。
quotes.author: Paul

quotes.en: Perfect love casteth out fear.
quotes.zh: 完全的爱，把恐惧赶了出去。
quotes.author: John

quotes.en: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask, and it shall be given him.
quotes.zh: 谁缺少智慧，就该开口去求，必得着。
quotes.author: James

quotes.en: This above all: to thine own self be true.
quotes.zh: 最重要的是：对自己要真诚。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so.
quotes.zh: 事情本无好坏，是想法把它分成了好坏。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Brevity is the soul of wit.
quotes.zh: 简洁，是才智的灵魂。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: There are more things in heaven and earth than are dreamt of in your philosophy.
quotes.zh: 天地之间的事物，远比你所能想到的更多。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Give every man thine ear, but few thy voice.
quotes.zh: 要多听人说话，却少对人开口。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Neither a borrower nor a lender be.
quotes.zh: 既不要向人借，也不要借钱给人。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: The readiness is all.
quotes.zh: 随时准备好，就什么都够了。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: We know what we are, but know not what we may be.
quotes.zh: 我们知道自己现在是什么，却不知道还能成为什么。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Tomorrow, and tomorrow, and tomorrow, creeps in this petty pace from day to day.
quotes.zh: 明天，明天，又一个明天，一天一天地挪着碎步。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: It is a tale told by an idiot, full of sound and fury, signifying nothing.
quotes.zh: 那是个傻子讲的故事，喧闹激烈，却什么也没说明。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: There is no art to find the mind's construction in the face.
quotes.zh: 没有哪种本领能只看脸就读出人心的构造。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: False face must hide what the false heart doth know.
quotes.zh: 虚伪的脸，必须掩住虚伪的心所知道的事。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Fair is foul, and foul is fair.
quotes.zh: 美即是丑，丑即是美。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Come what come may, time and the hour runs through the roughest day.
quotes.zh: 该来的就来吧，时间总会走过最艰难的一天。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: All the world is a stage, and all the men and women merely players.
quotes.zh: 整个世界是一座舞台，所有男女不过是演员。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: The fool doth think he is wise, but the wise man knows himself to be a fool.
quotes.zh: 愚人自以为聪明，智者却知道自己是个傻子。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Sweet are the uses of adversity.
quotes.zh: 逆境的滋味，细品竟是甜的。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Blow, blow, thou winter wind, thou art not so unkind as man's ingratitude.
quotes.zh: 吹吧，冬天的风，你还不如人的忘恩负义那样冷酷。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Do you not know I am a woman? When I think, I must speak.
quotes.zh: 难道你不知道我是女人吗？我一想到什么，就非说不可。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Fortune reigns in gifts of the world, but not in the lineaments of nature.
quotes.zh: 命运主宰着世间的馈赠，却管不到天性的模样。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.
quotes.zh: 有人生来就伟大，有人靠努力成就伟大，也有人被伟大推着走。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Better a witty fool than a foolish wit.
quotes.zh: 做机灵的傻子，胜过做愚蠢的聪明人。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Love sought is good, but given unsought is better.
quotes.zh: 求得来的爱固然好，不求自来的爱更好。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: If music be the food of love, play on.
quotes.zh: 如果音乐是爱情的食粮，那就继续演奏吧。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Time is the wisest counsellor of all.
quotes.zh: 时间是最明智的顾问。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Speak low if you speak love.
quotes.zh: 若要谈情，就把声音放低。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: There was never yet philosopher that could endure the toothache patiently.
quotes.zh: 从来没有哪个哲学家能耐心忍受牙痛。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Silence is the perfectest herald of joy.
quotes.zh: 沉默是传达喜悦最完美的使者。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Friendship is constant in all other things save in the office and affairs of love.
quotes.zh: 友谊在别的事上都稳固，唯独在爱情这件事上不牢。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Everyone can master a grief but he that has it.
quotes.zh: 谁都能驾驭别人的悲伤，除了那个正悲伤着的人。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Cowards die many times before their deaths; the valiant never taste of death but once.
quotes.zh: 懦夫死前要死许多次，勇者一生只尝到一次死亡。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
quotes.zh: 问题不在星象，而在我们自己身上。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Not that I loved Caesar less, but that I loved Rome more.
quotes.zh: 并非我爱凯撒少些，而是我爱罗马更多。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: There is a tide in the affairs of men, which taken at the flood leads on to fortune.
quotes.zh: 人间事务有一道潮水，趁着涨潮时把握它，就能通向好运。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: The evil that men do lives after them; the good is oft interred with their bones.
quotes.zh: 人们做的恶留在身后，做的善却常随尸骨埋掉。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: The quality of mercy is not strained; it droppeth as the gentle rain from heaven.
quotes.zh: 慈悲不是勉强的，它像细雨一样从天上自然落下。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: All that glisters is not gold.
quotes.zh: 闪闪发光的东西，未必都是黄金。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: How far that little candle throws his beams! So shines a good deed in a naughty world.
quotes.zh: 小小一支蜡烛也能照得很远，善行就这样照亮了这污浊的世界。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: If you prick us, do we not bleed?
quotes.zh: 你若刺我们，我们不也流血吗？
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: The devil can cite Scripture for his purpose.
quotes.zh: 魔鬼也能引经据典，为自己的目的作证。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Nothing will come of nothing.
quotes.zh: 从无中，什么也生不出来。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Men must endure their going hence, even as their coming hither.
quotes.zh: 人来时如此，去时也只能承受。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: How sharper than a serpent's tooth it is to have a thankless child!
quotes.zh: 养出一个不知感恩的孩子，比毒蛇的牙还要伤人。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: The art of our necessities is strange, and can make vile things precious.
quotes.zh: 穷困也会逼人显出本事，把贱物变成宝贝。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: We are such stuff as dreams are made on, and our little life is rounded with a sleep.
quotes.zh: 我们正是梦所织成的材料，短暂一生最后收拢于一场睡眠。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Misery acquaints a man with strange bedfellows.
quotes.zh: 落难的人，总会结识些奇怪的同伴。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: What is past is prologue.
quotes.zh: 过去的一切，都只是序幕。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Once more unto the breach, dear friends, once more.
quotes.zh: 亲爱的朋友们，再冲一次缺口，再冲一次。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: The fewer men, the greater share of honour.
quotes.zh: 人越少，每个人分到的荣誉就越多。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: Men of few words are the best men.
quotes.zh: 话少的人，往往才是最好的人。
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.en: All men by nature desire to know.
quotes.zh: 求知，是人的天性。
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.en: One swallow does not make a summer.
quotes.zh: 一只燕子飞过，还成不了夏天。
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.en: A friend is a second self.
quotes.zh: 朋友，是另一个自己。
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.en: The educated differ from the uneducated as much as the living from the dead.
quotes.zh: 受过教育的人与未受教育的人，差别如生者之于死者。
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.en: The whole is more than the sum of its parts.
quotes.zh: 整体大于各部分之和。
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.en: Nature does nothing in vain.
quotes.zh: 自然从不做无用之事。
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.en: He who cannot be a good follower cannot be a good leader.
quotes.zh: 连好追随者都做不成的人，也做不成好的领导者。
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.en: Piety requires us to honour truth above our friends.
quotes.zh: 敬重之心要求我们，把真相看得比朋友更重。
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.en: The aim of art is to represent not the outward appearance of things, but their inward significance.
quotes.zh: 艺术的目的，不是描摹事物的外形，而是表现它们内在的意义。
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.en: The greatest thing by far is to be a master of metaphor.
quotes.zh: 最了不起的本事，是驾驭比喻。
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.en: The direction in which education starts a man will determine his future life.
quotes.zh: 教育最初把人引向哪个方向，就决定了他今后的生活。
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.en: At the touch of love everyone becomes a poet.
quotes.zh: 一沾上爱情，人人都成了诗人。
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.en: Ignorance is the root and stem of all evil.
quotes.zh: 无知，是一切恶的根与干。
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.en: There is no harm in repeating a good thing.
quotes.zh: 把好事再说一遍，并没有什么坏处。
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.en: Beautiful things are difficult.
quotes.zh: 美好的事物，总是难以求得。
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.en: Wonder is the beginning of wisdom.
quotes.zh: 惊奇，是智慧的开端。
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.en: No human thing is of serious importance.
quotes.zh: 人间的种种，其实都不必看得太重。
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.en: The beginning is the most important part of the work.
quotes.zh: 开头，是整件工作中最重要的部分。
quotes.author: Plato

quotes.en: The unexamined life is not worth living.
quotes.zh: 不经省察的人生，不值得过。
quotes.author: Socrates

quotes.en: I know that I know nothing.
quotes.zh: 我知道自己什么也不知道。
quotes.author: Socrates

quotes.en: There is only one good, knowledge, and one evil, ignorance.
quotes.zh: 善只有一种，就是知识；恶只有一种，就是无知。
quotes.author: Socrates

quotes.en: Be as you wish to seem.
quotes.zh: 愿你实际的样子，就是你想被看见的样子。
quotes.author: Socrates

quotes.en: To do injustice is more disgraceful than to suffer it.
quotes.zh: 行不义之事，比遭受不义更可耻。
quotes.author: Socrates

quotes.en: If you have a garden and a library, you have everything you need.
quotes.zh: 有一座花园和一间书房，你所需的一切就都有了。
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.en: The welfare of the people is the ultimate law.
quotes.zh: 人民的福祉，就是最高的法律。
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.en: Friendship improves happiness and abates misery, by doubling our joys and dividing our griefs.
quotes.zh: 友谊能增添快乐、减轻痛苦，它把喜悦加倍，把悲伤减半。
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.en: The more laws, the less justice.
quotes.zh: 法律越多，公道反而越少。
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.en: History is the witness that testifies to the passing of time.
quotes.zh: 历史是见证，为流逝的时光作证。
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.en: In times of war, the law falls silent.
quotes.zh: 战乱之时，法律沉默。
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.en: We are all servants of the laws in order that we may be free.
quotes.zh: 我们守法，正是为了能够自由。
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.en: Virtue is its own reward.
quotes.zh: 德行本身就是它的报偿。
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.en: Gratitude is not only the greatest of virtues, but the parent of all others.
quotes.zh: 感恩不仅是最高的美德，也是其他一切美德之母。
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.en: The harvest of old age is the memory of past blessings.
quotes.zh: 老年收获的，是对往昔美好时光的回忆。
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.en: In peace, sons bury their fathers; in war, fathers bury their sons.
quotes.zh: 太平时，儿子埋葬父亲；战乱时，父亲埋葬儿子。
quotes.author: Herodotus

quotes.en: Great deeds are usually wrought at great risks.
quotes.zh: 伟大的事业，往往要冒极大的风险才能做成。
quotes.author: Herodotus

quotes.en: It is better to be envied than pitied.
quotes.zh: 被人羡慕，总好过被人怜悯。
quotes.author: Herodotus

quotes.en: Circumstances rule men; men do not rule circumstances.
quotes.zh: 环境支配人，而不是人支配环境。
quotes.author: Herodotus

quotes.en: The strong do what they can, and the weak suffer what they must.
quotes.zh: 强者做他们能做的，弱者受他们必须受的。
quotes.author: Thucydides

quotes.en: History is a possession for all time.
quotes.zh: 历史，是永久的财富。
quotes.author: Thucydides

quotes.en: The secret of happiness is freedom, and the secret of freedom is a brave heart.
quotes.zh: 幸福的秘密是自由，自由的秘密是一颗勇敢的心。
quotes.author: Thucydides

quotes.en: It is the habit of mankind to entrust to careless hope what they long for.
quotes.zh: 人总把渴望的东西，轻率地交给希望去保管。
quotes.author: Thucydides

quotes.en: The whole earth is the tomb of famous men.
quotes.zh: 整个大地，都是名人的坟墓。
quotes.author: Thucydides

quotes.en: Do not spoil what you have by desiring what you have not.
quotes.zh: 不要因为贪求没有的东西，毁掉已有的东西。
quotes.author: Epicurus

quotes.en: Death is nothing to us.
quotes.zh: 死亡与我们无关。
quotes.author: Epicurus

quotes.en: He who is not satisfied with a little is satisfied with nothing.
quotes.zh: 对一点点都不知足的人，什么也满足不了他。
quotes.author: Epicurus

quotes.en: It is not so much our friends' help that helps us, as the confidence of their help.
quotes.zh: 朋友帮我们的，不如我们相信他们会帮我们这件事更管用。
quotes.author: Epicurus

quotes.en: I have never desired to please the many.
quotes.zh: 我从没想过要讨众人的欢心。
quotes.author: Epicurus

quotes.en: The mind is not a vessel to be filled, but a fire to be kindled.
quotes.zh: 心灵不是要被填满的容器，而是要被点燃的火。
quotes.author: Plutarch

quotes.en: The measure of a man is the way he bears up under misfortune.
quotes.zh: 衡量一个人，要看他如何承受不幸。
quotes.author: Plutarch

quotes.en: To find fault is easy; to do better may be difficult.
quotes.zh: 挑毛病很容易，做得更好却难。
quotes.author: Plutarch

quotes.en: There is nothing sweeter than a man's own country and his parents.
quotes.zh: 没有什么比自己的故土和父母更令人亲切。
quotes.author: Homer

quotes.en: Men are like leaves, blown about by the wind.
quotes.zh: 人就像树叶，被风吹来吹去。
quotes.author: Homer

quotes.en: One omen is best: to fight for one's country.
quotes.zh: 最好的征兆，是为故土而战。
quotes.author: Homer

quotes.en: There is a time for many words, and there is also a time for sleep.
quotes.zh: 有时候该多说几句，有时候该去安睡。
quotes.author: Homer

quotes.en: Patient endurance is the mark of a good man.
quotes.zh: 能够忍耐，是好男儿的本色。
quotes.author: Homer

quotes.en: A man who has been through bitter experiences and travelled far enjoys even his sufferings after a time.
quotes.zh: 饱经忧患、远行万里的人，事后连自己的苦也能品出滋味。
quotes.author: Homer

quotes.en: Few sons are like their fathers.
quotes.zh: 很少有儿子能像自己的父亲。
quotes.author: Homer

quotes.en: How prone to doubt, how cautious are the wise!
quotes.zh: 有智慧的人，是多么容易怀疑、多么谨慎。
quotes.author: Homer

quotes.en: Many are the wonders of the world, but none more wonderful than man.
quotes.zh: 世间奇物众多，却没有一样比人更奇妙。
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.en: All men make mistakes, but a good man yields when he knows his course is wrong.
quotes.zh: 人人都会犯错，而好人一旦知道走错了路，就肯回头。
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.en: Wisdom is the supreme part of happiness.
quotes.zh: 智慧是幸福中最高的一部分。
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.en: Time alone reveals the just man; but you might know a bad man in a single day.
quotes.zh: 时间才能显出谁是正直的人，而坏人一天就能看穿。
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.en: No one loves the messenger who brings bad news.
quotes.zh: 没有人喜欢带来坏消息的传信人。
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.en: Great words, from those who are proud, are punished by the gods.
quotes.zh: 骄傲的人说的大话，会遭到神的惩罚。
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.en: One word frees us of all the weight and pain of life: that word is love.
quotes.zh: 有一个词能卸下人生所有的沉重与痛苦，那个词就是爱。
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.en: A lie never lives to be old.
quotes.zh: 谎言活不到老。
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.en: Time will reveal everything; it is a babbler, and speaks even when not asked.
quotes.zh: 时间会把一切揭出来，它是个多嘴的家伙，没人问它也开口。
quotes.author: Euripides

quotes.en: Whom the gods would destroy, they first make mad.
quotes.zh: 神要毁掉谁，就先让他发狂。
quotes.author: Euripides

quotes.en: Cleverness is not wisdom.
quotes.zh: 机灵并不等于智慧。
quotes.author: Euripides

quotes.en: One loyal friend is worth ten thousand relatives.
quotes.zh: 一个忠诚的朋友，抵得上万千亲戚。
quotes.author: Euripides

quotes.en: Everyone must pay the debt of death.
quotes.zh: 人人都要还清死亡这笔债。
quotes.author: Euripides

quotes.en: A bad beginning brings a bad end.
quotes.zh: 开头开得不好，结局也好不了。
quotes.author: Euripides

quotes.en: They can conquer who believe they can.
quotes.zh: 相信自己能行的人，就能够做到。
quotes.author: Virgil

quotes.en: Love conquers all things.
quotes.zh: 爱能征服一切。
quotes.author: Virgil

quotes.en: Happy is he who has been able to understand the causes of things.
quotes.zh: 能弄懂事物来由的人，是有福的。
quotes.author: Virgil

quotes.en: Perhaps someday it will be pleasant to remember even these things.
quotes.zh: 也许有一天，连这些事回想起来也会觉得甘甜。
quotes.author: Virgil

quotes.en: A new order of the ages is born.
quotes.zh: 一个崭新的时代正在诞生。
quotes.author: Virgil

quotes.en: Yield not to misfortunes, but advance all the more boldly against them.
quotes.zh: 不要在不幸面前退让，反而要更勇敢地迎上去。
quotes.author: Virgil

quotes.en: Mind moves matter.
quotes.zh: 心意能推动万物。
quotes.author: Virgil

quotes.en: Each man is carried away by his own pleasure.
quotes.zh: 每个人都被自己的喜好牵着走。
quotes.author: Virgil

quotes.en: Seize the day, trusting as little as possible in tomorrow.
quotes.zh: 抓住今天，别太指望明天。
quotes.author: Horace

quotes.en: A word once spoken can never be recalled.
quotes.zh: 话一旦说出口，就再也收不回来。
quotes.author: Horace

quotes.en: He who has begun has half done; dare to be wise.
quotes.zh: 开了头就等于做完一半，勇敢地去求知吧。
quotes.author: Horace

quotes.en: Anger is a short madness.
quotes.zh: 愤怒是一场短暂的疯狂。
quotes.author: Horace

quotes.en: Rule your mind or it will rule you.
quotes.zh: 你要管住自己的心，否则它就会管住你。
quotes.author: Horace

quotes.en: We are but dust and shadow.
quotes.zh: 我们不过是尘土与影子。
quotes.author: Horace

quotes.en: Choose a subject equal to your abilities.
quotes.zh: 要挑一个与自己的能力相称的题目。
quotes.author: Horace

quotes.en: Dripping water hollows out stone, not through force but through persistence.
quotes.zh: 滴水能穿石，靠的不是力气，而是坚持。
quotes.author: Ovid

quotes.en: A faithful study of the liberal arts humanizes character.
quotes.zh: 认真研习人文技艺，能使人性情温和。
quotes.author: Ovid

quotes.en: Time is the devourer of all things.
quotes.zh: 时间吞噬一切。
quotes.author: Ovid

quotes.en: Nothing is stronger than habit.
quotes.zh: 没有什么比习惯的力量更强。
quotes.author: Ovid

quotes.en: We can learn even from our enemies.
quotes.zh: 即使敌人身上，也有可学之处。
quotes.author: Ovid

quotes.en: Be patient and tough; someday this pain will be useful to you.
quotes.zh: 耐心一点，坚韧一点，总有一天这份苦会有用。
quotes.author: Ovid

quotes.en: As long as you are lucky, you will have many friends; if the sky grows dark, you will be alone.
quotes.zh: 走运时朋友很多，天色一暗，你就独自一人。
quotes.author: Ovid

quotes.en: A healthy mind in a healthy body.
quotes.zh: 健全的精神，寓于健全的身体。
quotes.author: Juvenal

quotes.en: Who will guard the guardians themselves?
quotes.zh: 守护者由谁来守护？
quotes.author: Juvenal

quotes.en: The people now ask for two things only: bread and circuses.
quotes.zh: 人们如今只求两样东西：面包和马戏。
quotes.author: Juvenal

quotes.en: Honesty is praised, and yet it starves.
quotes.zh: 诚实被人称赞，却常常饿肚子。
quotes.author: Juvenal

quotes.en: Dare something worthy of being written.
quotes.zh: 去做一件值得被写下来的事。
quotes.author: Juvenal

quotes.en: Revenge is the weak pleasure of a little mind.
quotes.zh: 报复，是狭隘心灵那点可怜的乐趣。
quotes.author: Juvenal

quotes.en: Reading maketh a full man, conference a ready man, and writing an exact man.
quotes.zh: 阅读使人充实，交谈使人机敏，动笔使人严谨。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: Knowledge is power.
quotes.zh: 知识就是力量。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed, and some few to be chewed and digested.
quotes.zh: 书有只需浅尝的，有可以吞下的，也有少数要细细咀嚼消化的。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: A wise man will make more opportunities than he finds.
quotes.zh: 有智慧的人创造机会，胜过他发现机会。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: Revenge is a kind of wild justice.
quotes.zh: 报复，是一种野生的正义。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: He that hath wife and children hath given hostages to fortune.
quotes.zh: 有了妻儿的人，就等于向命运交出了人质。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: Prosperity doth best discover vice, but adversity doth best discover virtue.
quotes.zh: 顺境最能暴露恶，逆境最能显露出美德。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: Men fear death as children fear to go in the dark.
quotes.zh: 人怕死，正如孩子怕走进黑暗。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: Virtue is like a rich stone, best plain set.
quotes.zh: 美德就像宝石，不加修饰的镶嵌反而最好。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: He that will not apply new remedies must expect new evils.
quotes.zh: 不肯用新办法的人，只能等着新的祸患。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: Nature, to be commanded, must be obeyed.
quotes.zh: 要支配自然，先得听从自然。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: Hope is a good breakfast, but it is a bad supper.
quotes.zh: 希望是顿好早餐，却是顿糟糕的晚饭。
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.en: The greatest thing in the world is to know how to belong to oneself.
quotes.zh: 世间最了不起的事，是懂得如何属于自己。
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: What do I know?
quotes.zh: 我知道什么呢？
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: I study myself more than any other subject.
quotes.zh: 我研究自己，胜过研究任何别的题目。
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: Nothing is so firmly believed as that which we least know.
quotes.zh: 我们最不了解的事，反而被信得最牢。
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: To forbid us anything is to make us have a mind to it.
quotes.zh: 越是禁止一件事，越让人惦记它。
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: He who fears he shall suffer already suffers what he fears.
quotes.zh: 害怕受苦的人，已经在受他所怕的苦了。
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: We are more interested in making others believe we are happy than in trying to be happy ourselves.
quotes.zh: 我们更在意让别人相信我们幸福，而不是真的让自己幸福。
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: Poverty of goods is easily cured; poverty of soul is irreparable.
quotes.zh: 缺钱容易补救，心灵贫乏却难以医治。
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: Custom is a second nature.
quotes.zh: 习惯是第二天性。
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: The most certain sign of wisdom is cheerfulness.
quotes.zh: 智慧最可靠的标志，是发自内心的开朗。
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: Even on the highest throne in the world, we are still sitting on our own bottom.
quotes.zh: 即使坐上世间最高的宝座，我们坐着的仍然是自己的屁股。
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: The value of life lies not in the length of days, but in the use we make of them.
quotes.zh: 人生的价值不在于活了多少天，而在于怎样使用这些日子。
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.en: The heart has its reasons which reason knows nothing of.
quotes.zh: 心自有它的道理，是理智所不懂的。
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.en: Man is but a reed, the weakest in nature, but he is a thinking reed.
quotes.zh: 人只是一根苇草，是自然里最脆弱的东西，但他是一根会思想的苇草。
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.en: All of humanity's problems stem from man's inability to sit quietly in a room alone.
quotes.zh: 人类的种种问题，都源于人无法独自安静地待在房间里。
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.en: Too much and too little wine: give him none, he cannot find truth; give him too much, the same.
quotes.zh: 酒太多或太少都不行：一滴不给，他找不到真相；给得太多，结果也一样。
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.en: Man's greatness comes from knowing he is wretched.
quotes.zh: 人的伟大，来自他自知可怜。
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.en: The present is never our end; past and present are means, the future is our end.
quotes.zh: 现在从不是我们的终点；过去与现在只是手段，未来才是目标。
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.en: Do you wish people to think well of you? Do not speak well of yourself.
quotes.zh: 你希望别人对你有好评吗？那就别自夸。
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.en: Imagination decides everything.
quotes.zh: 想象力决定一切。
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.en: Words arranged differently have a different meaning, and meanings arranged differently have a different effect.
quotes.zh: 词序不同，意思就不同；意思的次序不同，效果也不同。
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.en: In faith there is enough light for those who want to believe.
quotes.zh: 对于愿意相信的人，信念里已有足够的光。
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.en: I think, therefore I am.
quotes.zh: 我思故我在。
quotes.author: Rene Descartes

quotes.en: Doubt is the origin of wisdom.
quotes.zh: 怀疑，是智慧的开端。
quotes.author: Rene Descartes

quotes.en: Reading books is like conversing with the best men of past centuries.
quotes.zh: 读书，就像同过去几百年里最优秀的人交谈。
quotes.author: Rene Descartes

quotes.en: The greatest minds are capable of the greatest vices as well as the greatest virtues.
quotes.zh: 最杰出的头脑，既能成就最大的美德，也能犯下最大的恶行。
quotes.author: Rene Descartes

quotes.en: Nothing is more fairly distributed than common sense.
quotes.zh: 没有什么比常识分配得更公平。
quotes.author: Rene Descartes

quotes.en: It is not enough to have a good mind; the main thing is to use it well.
quotes.zh: 光有好脑子不够，关键在于把它用好。
quotes.author: Rene Descartes

quotes.en: All things excellent are as difficult as they are rare.
quotes.zh: 一切卓越之事，既难得，也艰难。
quotes.author: Baruch Spinoza

quotes.en: Do not weep; do not wax indignant. Understand.
quotes.zh: 不要哭，也不要愤怒，去理解。
quotes.author: Baruch Spinoza

quotes.en: Peace is not the absence of war; it is a virtue, a state of mind.
quotes.zh: 和平不是没有战争，而是一种美德，一种心境。
quotes.author: Baruch Spinoza

quotes.en: Nothing is more useful to man than man.
quotes.zh: 对人最有用的，莫过于人。
quotes.author: Baruch Spinoza

quotes.en: A free man thinks of death least of all things.
quotes.zh: 自由的人，最少想到的是死。
quotes.author: Baruch Spinoza

quotes.en: The life of man in the state of nature is solitary, poor, nasty, brutish, and short.
quotes.zh: 自然状态下的人生，孤独、贫困、卑污、野蛮而短暂。
quotes.author: Thomas Hobbes

quotes.en: Curiosity is the lust of the mind.
quotes.zh: 好奇，是心灵的欲望。
quotes.author: Thomas Hobbes

quotes.en: Words are wise men's counters; they do but reckon with them.
quotes.zh: 词语是智者的筹码，他们只是拿它来算账。
quotes.author: Thomas Hobbes

quotes.en: The condition of man is a condition of war of everyone against everyone.
quotes.zh: 人的处境，是一切人对一切人的战争。
quotes.author: Thomas Hobbes

quotes.en: Leisure is the mother of philosophy.
quotes.zh: 闲暇是哲学之母。
quotes.author: Thomas Hobbes

quotes.en: A penny saved is a penny got.
quotes.zh: 省一分钱就是挣一分钱。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise.
quotes.zh: 早睡早起，使人健康、富足又聪明。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Lost time is never found again.
quotes.zh: 失去的时间永远找不回来。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: God helps them that help themselves.
quotes.zh: 天助自助者。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Never leave that till tomorrow which you can do today.
quotes.zh: 今天能做的事，绝不要留到明天。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Keep thy shop, and thy shop will keep thee.
quotes.zh: 守好你的店铺，店铺自会养活你。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Three may keep a secret, if two of them are dead.
quotes.zh: 三个人能守住秘密，除非其中两个已经死了。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Love your enemies, for they tell you your faults.
quotes.zh: 爱你的敌人，因为他们会指出你的过错。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Diligence is the mother of good luck.
quotes.zh: 勤奋是好运之母。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Experience keeps a dear school, but fools will learn in no other.
quotes.zh: 经验是一所昂贵的学校，愚人却只能在那里学会。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Beware of little expenses; a small leak will sink a great ship.
quotes.zh: 当心小额开支；小漏洞也能沉掉大船。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Well done is better than well said.
quotes.zh: 做得好胜过说得好。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Fish and visitors smell in three days.
quotes.zh: 鱼和客人，三天就变味。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: If you would be wealthy, think of saving as well as of getting.
quotes.zh: 想致富，就要一边挣钱一边省钱。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Either write things worth reading, or do things worth writing.
quotes.zh: 要么写值得读的东西，要么做值得写的事。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: Remember that time is money.
quotes.zh: 记住，时间就是金钱。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: In this world nothing can be said to be certain, except death and taxes.
quotes.zh: 这世上除了死亡和税收，没有什么是确定的。
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.en: We hold these truths to be self-evident, that all men are created equal.
quotes.zh: 我们认为这些真理不言而喻：人人生而平等。
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.en: I cannot live without books.
quotes.zh: 没有书，我活不下去。
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.en: The tree of liberty must be refreshed from time to time with the blood of patriots and tyrants.
quotes.zh: 自由之树必须时时用爱国者和暴君的鲜血来浇灌。
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.en: Delay is preferable to error.
quotes.zh: 拖延胜过出错。
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.en: Honesty is the first chapter in the book of wisdom.
quotes.zh: 诚实是智慧之书的第一章。
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.en: A little rebellion now and then is a good thing.
quotes.zh: 偶尔来一场小反抗是件好事。
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.en: Error of opinion may be tolerated where reason is left free to combat it.
quotes.zh: 只要理性仍能自由驳斥，错误意见就可以被容忍。
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.en: The care of human life and happiness is the first and only legitimate object of good government.
quotes.zh: 护佑人的生命与幸福，是好政府首要而唯一正当的目标。
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.en: To be prepared for war is one of the most effectual means of preserving peace.
quotes.zh: 备战是维护和平最有效的手段之一。
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.en: Discipline is the soul of an army.
quotes.zh: 纪律是军队的灵魂。
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.en: Labour to keep alive in your breast that little spark of celestial fire called conscience.
quotes.zh: 努力让胸中那点名为良心的天火长燃不熄。
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.en: Observe good faith and justice towards all nations.
quotes.zh: 对所有国家都秉持诚信与公正。
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.en: It is better to offer no excuse than a bad one.
quotes.zh: 宁可不找借口，也不要找个烂借口。
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.en: These are the times that try men's souls.
quotes.zh: 这是考验人心灵的时刻。
quotes.author: Thomas Paine

quotes.en: The harder the conflict, the more glorious the triumph.
quotes.zh: 斗争越艰难，胜利越光荣。
quotes.author: Thomas Paine

quotes.en: That which we obtain too easily, we esteem too lightly.
quotes.zh: 太容易得到的东西，我们往往看得太轻。
quotes.author: Thomas Paine

quotes.en: Government, even in its best state, is but a necessary evil.
quotes.zh: 政府即使处于最佳状态，也不过是一种必要的恶。
quotes.author: Thomas Paine

quotes.en: A long habit of not thinking a thing wrong gives it a superficial appearance of being right.
quotes.zh: 长久不去想一件事是错的，它就会披上正确的外衣。
quotes.author: Thomas Paine

quotes.en: My country is the world, and my religion is to do good.
quotes.zh: 我的国家是整个世界，我的信仰是行善。
quotes.author: Thomas Paine

quotes.en: A house divided against itself cannot stand.
quotes.zh: 分裂的家是站不住的。
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.en: Government of the people, by the people, for the people, shall not perish from the earth.
quotes.zh: 民有、民治、民享的政府，不会从地上消亡。
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.en: With malice toward none, with charity for all.
quotes.zh: 对谁也不怀恶意，对所有人宽厚仁慈。
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.en: Let us have faith that right makes might.
quotes.zh: 让我们相信，正义能生出力量。
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.en: The ballot is stronger than the bullet.
quotes.zh: 选票比子弹更有力量。
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.en: Those who deny freedom to others deserve it not for themselves.
quotes.zh: 剥夺他人自由的人，自己也不配享有自由。
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.en: The sacred rights of mankind are not to be rummaged for among old parchments.
quotes.zh: 人类的神圣权利，不必到旧羊皮纸里翻找。
quotes.author: Alexander Hamilton

quotes.en: Energy in the executive is a leading character in the definition of good government.
quotes.zh: 行政部门的活力，是良政定义中的首要特征。
quotes.author: Alexander Hamilton

quotes.en: The means of defense against foreign danger have been always the instruments of tyranny at home.
quotes.zh: 抵御外敌的手段，历来都会变成对内暴政的工具。
quotes.author: Alexander Hamilton

quotes.en: Here, sir, the people govern.
quotes.zh: 先生，在这里是人民在治理。
quotes.author: Alexander Hamilton

quotes.en: Liberty cannot be preserved without a general knowledge among the people.
quotes.zh: 民众没有普遍的知识，自由就无法保全。
quotes.author: John Adams
quotes.source: Dissertation on the Canon and Feudal Law, 1765

quotes.en: I must study politics and war, that our sons may have liberty to study mathematics and philosophy.
quotes.zh: 我必须研究政治与战争，好让儿子们有空闲学数学与哲学。
quotes.author: John Adams

quotes.en: The happiness of society is the end of government.
quotes.zh: 社会的幸福是政府的目的。
quotes.author: John Adams

quotes.en: Facts are stubborn things, and whatever may be our wishes, they cannot alter the state of facts and evidence.
quotes.zh: 事实是顽固的，无论我们怎样希望，都改变不了事实与证据。
quotes.author: John Adams
quotes.source: argument in defense of the soldiers, 1770

quotes.en: Trust thyself: every heart vibrates to that iron string.
quotes.zh: 相信你自己：每颗心都会应和那根铁弦。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: Whoso would be a man must be a nonconformist.
quotes.zh: 想成为真正的人，就必须不随波逐流。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
quotes.zh: 没有热情，就从未成就过任何伟大的事。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: A foolish consistency is the hobgoblin of little minds.
quotes.zh: 愚蠢的始终如一，是小心灵的鬼怪。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: The only way to have a friend is to be one.
quotes.zh: 想拥有朋友，唯一的办法就是自己先做朋友。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: Nature always wears the colors of the spirit.
quotes.zh: 自然永远披着心灵的颜色。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: Books are the best of things, well used; abused, among the worst.
quotes.zh: 书用得好是最好的东西，用坏了则是最坏的东西之一。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: Beauty is the mark God sets upon virtue.
quotes.zh: 美是上帝为德行留下的印记。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: Hitch your wagon to a star.
quotes.zh: 把你的车挂到星星上。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: Nothing can bring you peace but yourself.
quotes.zh: 除了你自己，没有什么能给你安宁。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: Insist on yourself; never imitate.
quotes.zh: 坚持做你自己，永不要模仿。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: A hero is no braver than an ordinary man, but he is brave five minutes longer.
quotes.zh: 英雄并不比常人更勇敢，只是他多勇敢了五分钟。
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.en: The mass of men lead lives of quiet desperation.
quotes.zh: 大多数人过着平静的绝望生活。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately.
quotes.zh: 我走进森林，是因为我想有意识地生活。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: Simplicity, simplicity, simplicity! I say, let your affairs be as two or three, not a hundred or a thousand.
quotes.zh: 简单，简单，再简单！我说，让你的事务只有两三件，而不是成百上千件。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: If a man does not keep pace with his companions, perhaps it is because he hears a different drummer.
quotes.zh: 如果一个人跟不上同伴的脚步，也许是因为他听见了另一种鼓点。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: Time is but the stream I go a-fishing in.
quotes.zh: 时间不过是我垂钓的那条溪流。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: The price of anything is the amount of life you exchange for it.
quotes.zh: 任何东西的代价，都是你为它换出去的那部分生命。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: A man is rich in proportion to the number of things which he can afford to let alone.
quotes.zh: 一个人有多富有，取决于他能放下多少东西。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: It is never too late to give up our prejudices.
quotes.zh: 放下偏见，永远不会太晚。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: Rather than love, than money, than fame, give me truth.
quotes.zh: 比起爱情、金钱和名声，我更想要真相。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: I have never found a companion that was so companionable as solitude.
quotes.zh: 我从未找到比独处更合得来的伙伴。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: Most of the luxuries and many of the so-called comforts of life are not only not indispensable, but positive hindrances.
quotes.zh: 大多数奢侈品和许多所谓的生活舒适品，不仅并非必需，反而是实实在在的阻碍。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: Our life is frittered away by detail.
quotes.zh: 我们的生命被琐碎的细节消磨掉了。
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.en: I am large, I contain multitudes.
quotes.zh: 我辽阔广大，我包罗万象。
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.en: I celebrate myself, and sing myself.
quotes.zh: 我赞美我自己，歌唱我自己。
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.en: Do I contradict myself? Very well then I contradict myself.
quotes.zh: 我自相矛盾吗？那好吧，我就是自相矛盾。
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.en: I hear America singing, the varied carols I hear.
quotes.zh: 我听见美国在歌唱，听见种种不同的歌。
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.en: Afoot and light-hearted I take to the open road.
quotes.zh: 我轻快地步行，走上开阔的道路。
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.en: I exist as I am, that is enough.
quotes.zh: 我以我的样子存在，这就够了。
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.en: The powerful play goes on, and you may contribute a verse.
quotes.zh: 宏大的戏剧仍在继续，你可以贡献一行诗。
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.en: I believe a leaf of grass is no less than the journey-work of the stars.
quotes.zh: 我相信一片草叶，不亚于星辰的远行之作。
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.en: Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul.
quotes.zh: 希望是有羽毛的东西，栖在灵魂里。
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.en: I'm nobody! Who are you?
quotes.zh: 我是无名之辈！你是谁？
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.en: Because I could not stop for Death, he kindly stopped for me.
quotes.zh: 因为我停不下脚步等死亡，他便好心地停下来等我。
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.en: Tell all the truth but tell it slant.
quotes.zh: 把全部真相都说出来，但要说得委婉。
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.en: Success is counted sweetest by those who ne'er succeed.
quotes.zh: 从未成功的人，最懂得成功的甜美。
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.en: The brain is wider than the sky.
quotes.zh: 大脑比天空更宽广。
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.en: Much madness is divinest sense.
quotes.zh: 许多疯狂，其实是最神圣的理智。
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.en: If I can stop one heart from breaking, I shall not live in vain.
quotes.zh: 只要我能让一颗心免于破碎，我就没有白活。
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.en: Let us, then, be up and doing, with a heart for any fate.
quotes.zh: 那么，让我们起身行动，以一颗能面对任何命运的心。
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.en: Life is real! Life is earnest!
quotes.zh: 生命是真实的！生命是严肃的！
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.en: The heights by great men reached and kept were not attained by sudden flight.
quotes.zh: 伟人所达到并守住的高度，并非一蹴而就。
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.en: Into each life some rain must fall.
quotes.zh: 每个人的生命里都会落下一场雨。
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.en: Be still, sad heart, and cease repining; behind the clouds is the sun still shining.
quotes.zh: 安静吧，忧伤的心，别再哀叹；云层背后太阳依旧照耀。
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.en: Music is the universal language of mankind.
quotes.zh: 音乐是全人类共同的语言。
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.en: Be true! Be true! Show freely to the world, if not your worst, yet some trait whereby the worst may be inferred.
quotes.zh: 要真实！要真实！向世界坦然显露，纵然不是最糟的一面，也要露出能让人推知最糟一面的痕迹。
quotes.author: Nathaniel Hawthorne

quotes.en: Time flies over us, but leaves its shadow behind.
quotes.zh: 时间从我们头顶飞过，却把影子留下。
quotes.author: Nathaniel Hawthorne

quotes.en: The mind of a bigot is like the pupil of the eye; the more light you pour upon it, the more it will contract.
quotes.zh: 偏执者的心智像瞳孔；你照进的光越多，它缩得越小。
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes

quotes.en: Speak clearly, if you speak at all; carve every word before you let it fall.
quotes.zh: 要说话就说清楚；每个字出口前先雕琢好。
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes

quotes.en: He who moves not forward, goes backward.
quotes.zh: 不进则退。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: A man sees in the world what he carries in his heart.
quotes.zh: 一个人在世上看到的，是他心里装着的东西。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: We are shaped and fashioned by what we love.
quotes.zh: 我们所爱之物造就了我们。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: One ought, every day at least, to hear a little song, read a good poem, see a fine picture.
quotes.zh: 人每天至少该听一首小曲，读一首好诗，看一幅好画。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
quotes.zh: 知道还不够，我们必须去用；愿意还不够，我们必须去做。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: Nothing is more terrible than ignorance in action.
quotes.zh: 没有比无知加上行动更可怕的事了。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: Before you can do something you must first be something.
quotes.zh: 在做成什么事之前，你得先成为什么样的人。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: Everything is simpler than you think and at the same time more complex than you imagine.
quotes.zh: 万事都比你想的简单，同时又比你想象的复杂。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: Treat people as if they were what they ought to be, and you help them become what they are capable of being.
quotes.zh: 把人当作他们该成为的样子来对待，你就帮他们成为了他们能成为的人。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: Correction does much, but encouragement does more.
quotes.zh: 批评很有用，鼓励更有用。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: The greatest genius will never be worth much if he pretends to draw exclusively from his own resources.
quotes.zh: 再大的天才，若只肯从自身汲取，也不会太有价值。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: If you treat an individual as he is, he will remain as he is.
quotes.zh: 你若按一个人现在的样子对待他，他就永远只是现在的样子。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: The soul that companies with virtue is like an ever-flowing stream.
quotes.zh: 与美德为伴的灵魂，像一条奔流不息的溪水。
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.en: Against stupidity the gods themselves contend in vain.
quotes.zh: 面对愚蠢，连众神也徒然抗争。
quotes.author: Friedrich Schiller

quotes.en: Keep true to the dreams of thy youth.
quotes.zh: 对你年轻时的梦想保持忠诚。
quotes.author: Friedrich Schiller

quotes.en: A brave mind is always impregnable.
quotes.zh: 勇敢的心永远无法被攻破。
quotes.author: Friedrich Schiller

quotes.en: He who has never hoped can never despair.
quotes.zh: 从未怀抱希望的人，也永远无法绝望。
quotes.author: Friedrich Schiller

quotes.en: The voice of the majority is no proof of justice.
quotes.zh: 多数人的声音，并不能证明公正。
quotes.author: Friedrich Schiller

quotes.en: Art is the right hand of nature.
quotes.zh: 艺术是自然的右手。
quotes.author: Friedrich Schiller
quotes.source: Über die ästhetische Erziehung des Menschen

quotes.en: Sapere aude! Have courage to use your own understanding.
quotes.zh: 敢于求知！要有勇气运用你自己的理解力。
quotes.author: Immanuel Kant

quotes.en: Enlightenment is man's emergence from his self-imposed immaturity.
quotes.zh: 启蒙就是人挣脱自己加给自己的不成熟。
quotes.author: Immanuel Kant

quotes.en: Two things fill the mind with ever new and increasing admiration and awe: the starry heavens above me and the moral law within me.
quotes.zh: 有两样东西让心灵充满常新的赞叹与敬畏：我头上的星空和我心中的道德律。
quotes.author: Immanuel Kant

quotes.en: Act only according to that maxim whereby you can at the same time will that it should become a universal law.
quotes.zh: 只按你能同时愿意它成为普遍法则的准则去行动。
quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.source: Groundwork of the Metaphysics of Morals

quotes.en: Man must be disciplined, for he is by nature raw and wild.
quotes.zh: 人必须受约束，因为他天性粗野。
quotes.author: Immanuel Kant

quotes.en: He who is cruel to animals becomes hard also in his dealings with men.
quotes.zh: 对动物残忍的人，待人也会变得冷酷。
quotes.author: Immanuel Kant

quotes.en: That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
quotes.zh: 杀不死我们的，使我们更强。
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.en: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
quotes.zh: 一个人只要有活下去的理由，就几乎能承受任何活法。
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.en: Without music, life would be a mistake.
quotes.zh: 没有音乐，生命就是一个错误。
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.en: In individuals, insanity is rare; but in groups, parties, nations, and epochs, it is the rule.
quotes.zh: 个人身上，疯狂是例外；在群体、党派、民族和时代里，它是常态。
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.en: Battle not with monsters, lest ye become a monster.
quotes.zh: 与怪物搏斗，当心自己也变成怪物。
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.en: There are no facts, only interpretations.
quotes.zh: 没有事实，只有解释。
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.en: One must still have chaos in oneself to be able to give birth to a dancing star.
quotes.zh: 人心中必须仍有混沌，才能生出跳舞的星辰。
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.en: Become what you are.
quotes.zh: 成为你本来就是的样子。
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.en: Talent hits a target no one else can hit; genius hits a target no one else can see.
quotes.zh: 才华击中别人打不中的靶子；天才击中别人看不见的靶子。
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.source: The World as Will and Representation

quotes.en: The two enemies of human happiness are pain and boredom.
quotes.zh: 人类幸福的两个敌人是痛苦和无聊。
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.en: Mostly it is loss which teaches us about the worth of things.
quotes.zh: 让我们懂得事物价值的，多半是失去。
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.en: Every man takes the limits of his own field of vision for the limits of the world.
quotes.zh: 每个人都把自己视野的边界，当成世界的边界。
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.en: A man can do what he wills, but he cannot will what he wills.
quotes.zh: 人能按自己的意愿行事，却不能决定自己有什么意愿。
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.source: On the Freedom of the Will

quotes.en: Wealth is like sea-water; the more we drink, the thirstier we become.
quotes.zh: 财富像海水，喝得越多越渴。
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.en: The only thing we learn from history is that we learn nothing from history.
quotes.zh: 我们从历史中学到的唯一教训，就是我们什么也没学到。
quotes.author: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel
quotes.source: Lectures on the Philosophy of History

quotes.en: What is rational is actual and what is actual is rational.
quotes.zh: 理性的就是现实的，现实的就是理性的。
quotes.author: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel
quotes.source: Elements of the Philosophy of Right

quotes.en: Nothing great in the world has ever been accomplished without passion.
quotes.zh: 世上从未有不靠热情完成的伟大事业。
quotes.author: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel
quotes.source: Lectures on the Philosophy of History

quotes.en: The owl of Minerva spreads its wings only with the falling of the dusk.
quotes.zh: 密涅瓦的猫头鹰要到黄昏才展开翅膀。
quotes.author: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel
quotes.source: Elements of the Philosophy of Right

quotes.en: Where they have burned books, they will end in burning human beings.
quotes.zh: 他们焚书的地方，最终也会焚人。
quotes.author: Heinrich Heine

quotes.en: I do not know what ails me, I am so sad.
quotes.zh: 我不知道自己怎么了，我只是这样忧伤。
quotes.author: Heinrich Heine

quotes.en: God will forgive me; that is his business.
quotes.zh: 上帝会宽恕我的，那是他的事。
quotes.author: Heinrich Heine

quotes.en: A lie is like a snowball: the further you roll it, the bigger it becomes.
quotes.zh: 谎言像雪球，滚得越远，变得越大。
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.en: Even if I knew that tomorrow the world would go to pieces, I would still plant my apple tree.
quotes.zh: 即使我知道明天世界就要毁灭，我仍会种下我的苹果树。
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.en: Music is the art of the prophets, the only art that can calm the agitations of the soul.
quotes.zh: 音乐是先知的艺术，是唯一能平息灵魂躁动的艺术。
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.en: Faith is a living, daring confidence in God's grace.
quotes.zh: 信仰是对上帝恩典一种鲜活而大胆的信靠。
quotes.author: Martin Luther
quotes.source: Preface to the Epistle to the Romans

quotes.en: Common sense is not so common.
quotes.zh: 常识并不那么常见。
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.en: The perfect is the enemy of the good.
quotes.zh: 完美是好的敌人。
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.en: We must cultivate our garden.
quotes.zh: 我们必须耕耘自己的园地。
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.en: Work saves us from three great evils: boredom, vice and need.
quotes.zh: 工作让我们免于三大祸害：无聊、恶习和匮乏。
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.en: Doubt is not a pleasant condition, but certainty is absurd.
quotes.zh: 怀疑并不令人愉快，但确信是荒谬的。
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.en: To the living we owe respect, but to the dead we owe only the truth.
quotes.zh: 对生者我们欠以尊重，对死者我们只欠以真相。
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.en: If God did not exist, it would be necessary to invent him.
quotes.zh: 假如上帝不存在，也有必要把他创造出来。
quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.source: Épître à l'auteur du livre des Trois imposteurs

quotes.en: A witty saying proves nothing.
quotes.zh: 一句俏皮话证明不了任何东西。
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.en: It is dangerous to be right when the government is wrong.
quotes.zh: 当政府错了，你站在正确一边是危险的。
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.en: Every man is guilty of all the good he did not do.
quotes.zh: 每个人都为自己未曾行过的善而负有罪责。
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.en: Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains.
quotes.zh: 人生而自由，却处处身戴锁链。
quotes.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quotes.en: The strongest is never strong enough to be always the master, unless he transforms strength into right.
quotes.zh: 再强的人也不足以永远做主人，除非他把强力转化为权利。
quotes.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quotes.en: Conscience is the voice of the soul.
quotes.zh: 良心是灵魂的声音。
quotes.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quotes.en: Everything is good as it leaves the hands of the Author of things; everything degenerates in the hands of man.
quotes.zh: 万物出自造物主之手时都是好的，到了人手里就变坏了。
quotes.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quotes.en: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
quotes.zh: 忍耐是苦的，但它的果实是甜的。
quotes.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quotes.en: The world of reality has its limits; the world of imagination is boundless.
quotes.zh: 现实世界有边界，想象世界无边无际。
quotes.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quotes.en: I prefer liberty with danger to peace with slavery.
quotes.zh: 我宁愿要带危险的自由，也不要带奴役的安宁。
quotes.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quotes.en: Man's first language, the most universal, the most energetic, is the cry of nature.
quotes.zh: 人类最初的语言，最普遍、最有力量的语言，是自然的呼喊。
quotes.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
quotes.source: Essay on the Origin of Languages

quotes.en: Our virtues are often, in reality, nothing but vices disguised.
quotes.zh: 我们的美德，往往不过是伪装起来的恶习。
quotes.author: La Rochefoucauld

quotes.en: We are so accustomed to disguise ourselves to others that at last we disguise ourselves to ourselves.
quotes.zh: 我们太习惯对别人伪装，最后连对自己也伪装起来。
quotes.author: La Rochefoucauld

quotes.en: Nothing is so contagious as example.
quotes.zh: 没有什么比榜样更有传染力。
quotes.author: La Rochefoucauld

quotes.en: The mind is always the dupe of the heart.
quotes.zh: 理智总是心灵的受骗者。
quotes.author: La Rochefoucauld

quotes.en: Absence diminishes mediocre passions and increases great ones.
quotes.zh: 离别会削弱平庸的感情，却会加深伟大的感情。
quotes.author: La Rochefoucauld

quotes.en: We sometimes think we hate flattery, when we only hate the way it is done.
quotes.zh: 有时我们以为讨厌奉承，其实只是讨厌奉承的方式。
quotes.author: La Rochefoucauld

quotes.en: It is easier to be wise for others than for ourselves.
quotes.zh: 替别人出主意容易，替自己聪明难。
quotes.author: La Rochefoucauld

quotes.en: No man is clever enough to know all the evil he does.
